tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and screen background on web and mobile. The camera role always uses the dark value.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, table rows, tiles, sheets and inputs that sit on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, meter tracks, the viewfinder field and the score 0 chip.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel outlines. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, switches, secondary buttons and the dashed No reading outline. 3:1 or better on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every soft fill. Also the fill of the Overdue badge.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Units, ages, captions and secondary text on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken, signal-soft and flag-soft.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The brand colour: primary buttons, the live estimate line, the selected nav item and progress. Text and icons in signal read on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and signal-soft. Never means normal or healthy.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the selected nav item and the Live tag background.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill.

tokens.name: flag
tokens.usage: Trend flag text, icon and border on surface, surface-raised and flag-soft. Always with the flag icon and the words Trend flag.

tokens.name: flag-soft
tokens.usage: Trend flag badge, flagged row and push banner background.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Score 3 and destructive actions such as deleting face data. Text in critical reads on surface, surface-raised and critical-soft.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Background of destructive confirmations.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a critical fill, including the score 3 chip.

tokens.name: overdue
tokens.usage: Fill of the Overdue badge: the inverse of the page, so it outranks every tinted badge by lightness alone.

tokens.name: on-overdue
tokens.usage: Text and icon on the overdue fill.

tokens.name: score-0
tokens.usage: Partial NEWS2 score 0 chip. Digit in ink.

tokens.name: score-1
tokens.usage: Partial NEWS2 score 1 chip. Digit in ink.

tokens.name: score-2
tokens.usage: Partial NEWS2 score 2 chip. Digit in on-score-2.

tokens.name: on-score-2
tokens.usage: Digit on the score-2 fill in both themes.

tokens.name: score-3
tokens.usage: Partial NEWS2 score 3 chip. Digit in on-critical.

tokens.name: series-estimate
tokens.usage: Camera estimate line on the reference chart: solid, 2px.

tokens.name: series-reference
tokens.usage: Reference device line on the reference chart: dashed, 2px. Told apart from the estimate by dash and lightness, not hue.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px so a surface gap separates it from filled controls. 3:1 or better on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and the consent dialog.

families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: readout-xl
styles.usage: The live value at check-in and the ticket number shown to the patient.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: Values in tiles, the sitting summary and the mobile ticket header.

styles.name: readout-md
styles.usage: Values in worklist rows, the timer and chart tooltips.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One per screen: the page or screen title.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Group headings inside a panel, list row titles on mobile.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text on the web dashboard.

styles.name: body-touch
styles.sample: Sit still and face the phone.
styles.usage: Default text in the mobile roles and anything a patient reads.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, tags, table headers, field labels. Sentence case, never all caps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, badge inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, list row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on web, screen gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panels, sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on the dashboard.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections. Also the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of a patient-facing screen, above the ticket number.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Score chips, provenance tags, meter tracks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, tiles, tables, the viewfinder.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Mobile sheets, push banners and role cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tile-state badges and the switch only. Nothing else is a pill.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Sheets, the push banner and chart tooltips: things that float above the page. Panels and tiles have no shadow; they use a line outline.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and inputs on the web dashboard.

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and list rows in the mobile roles.

tokens.name: nav-width
tokens.usage: Width of the dashboard side navigation.

tokens.name: phone-width
tokens.usage: Reference width for mobile layouts.
